records.specialty: Uses a spectral hand to manipulate doors, switches, evidence, and traps from a distance.

game_level_1.system_upgrade: Apply the starting curated D&D level 5-equivalent Fighter package.

game_level_2.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 9-equivalent Fighter package; limited-power uses become 2.

game_level_3.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 13-equivalent Fighter package; limited-power uses become 3.

game_level_4.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 17-equivalent Fighter package, including a major class-feature, combat-stat, armor/resource, and existing-power upgrade; limited-power uses become 4.

game_level_5.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 20-equivalent Fighter capstone package; limited-power uses become 5 and no further in-session levels are allowed.
